title: Move fdr-lambda-docs into FDR on Kubernetes
ask: Serve AI example enhancement from FDR on Kubernetes, so that it survives the 10-17 registry cutover and the Lambda and its database can be deleted.

headsups.title: A redirect gives every old CLI a 401
headsups.ticket_says: AC 3.1: redirect old CLIs to FDR.
headsups.body: Node `fetch` drops `Authorization` on a cross-origin 307/308. The Lambda must proxy: forward the body and the header, and return FDR's answer.

headsups.title: FDR cannot call Bedrock yet
headsups.body: FDR's role has no `bedrock:InvokeModel`. After the cutover every cache miss fails until the parcel IAM lands. FSDK-2072 needs the same fix.

headsups.title: The AC 4 dev test cannot reach beta
headsups.ticket_says: AC 4: test with a dev Lambda in the Fern account, in `fern-api/fern-platform`.
headsups.body: Beta FDR is internal (WARP only), and that repo is frozen. Run the proxy handler locally on WARP against beta FDR; the code goes to `postman-eng/sdk-gen-fern-platform`.

headsups.title: This move is also a fix
headsups.body: 231k of 390k calls a day hit a skip row cached from an August 401. Copy only `status='success'` rows to FDR, or the stale rows keep hiding examples.

An answer slower than the CLI's 15 s timeout: the CLI keeps the original example.

facts.text: Released CLIs call the raw Function URL `…lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws`, an AWS-owned host name, so DNS cannot move it.
Node `fetch` keeps the body but drops `Authorization` on a cross-origin 307/308; on 301/302 it switches to GET with no body.
FDR's prod IAM role has no Bedrock permission; its policies are sqsConsumer, s3Writer, s3Reader.
In 24 h: 390k calls = 147k cache hits + 5k misses + 231k skip hits. The skip rows come from an AI Gateway 401 in August.
Beta FDR resolves to an internal ingress (100.72.x.x): reachable on WARP only.
The beta CLI has AI enhancement off: `build.beta.mjs` sets `DEFAULT_FDR_LAMBDA_DOCS_ORIGIN: ""`.
The CLI calls with a 15 s timeout and 0 retries, and keeps the original example on any failure.
`registry.buildwithfern.com` moves to k8s FDR on 2026-10-17. Until then `fern-api/fern-platform` is frozen and schema migrations are not allowed.
facts.source: Wiki: Fern code freeze Oct 2 to Oct 17 2026

facts.text: FDR already serves `POST /v2/registry/ai/enhance-example` with Bedrock `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6` (40 s timeout) and `checkUserBelongsToOrg`.
FDR's HPA scales 3–50 pods at 60% CPU.
The Lambda's CDK (`docs-ai.buildwithfern.com`) was never deployed: the host does not resolve.

glossary.means: During `fern generate` and `fern docs`, the CLI sends each endpoint's request and response examples to an LLM, which makes them realistic.
Fern Definition Registry: the API the CLI registers APIs and docs with.
A cache row that says "do not enhance this example". The Lambda answers it with no example.
The auth service. It turns a `fern_` org token into the short-lived JWT the CLI sends.
The VPN that reaches Postman's internal hosts, such as beta FDR.
The program-wide move of `registry.buildwithfern.com` to k8s FDR on 2026-10-17.
Postman's deploy config for one service (IAM, scaling, env), in the `cloud9-parcels-*` repos.
Arie Litovsky, who filed the ticket and owns its acceptance criteria.
